author: Unity
description:
Unity's Physics Debugger is a built-in tool that visualizes colliders, raycasts, and other physics queries directly in the Scene view; no custom gizmos required. In this tip, see how the Physics Debugger helps you quickly spot common issues like missing colliders and misaligned raycasts, plus learn how to filter the visualization to focus on exactly what you need.

#Unity3D #GameDev #UnityTips #UnityLearn
title: Unity’s Physics Debugger
